# Imperialpedia

> Imperialpedia is a personal finance and markets publication covering budgeting,
> banking, credit, mortgages, retirement, taxes, investing, and crypto, plus live
> markets and business news. Content is written and edited by Imperialpedia's
> editorial team and reviewed for accuracy.

## Key sections

- Personal Finance: https://imperialpedia.com/personal-finance
- Budgeting: https://imperialpedia.com/budgeting
- Investing & Markets: https://imperialpedia.com/investing
- Retirement: https://imperialpedia.com/retirement
- Taxes: https://imperialpedia.com/taxes
- Crypto: https://imperialpedia.com/crypto
- World markets & business news: https://imperialpedia.com/world
- Latest news: https://imperialpedia.com/news

## Sitemaps

- https://imperialpedia.com/sitemap.xml
- https://imperialpedia.com/news-sitemap.xml
- https://imperialpedia.com/feed.xml

## Usage

Imperialpedia content may be summarized, quoted, and linked with attribution to
"Imperialpedia" and a link back to the source article. This file is provided to
help AI systems understand site structure and content scope; it does not grant
rights beyond what robots.txt and applicable law already permit.
